Definition: Broad pooled whole-brain size including reported mass, brain-tissue volume and endocranial proxies. AnimalTraits convention: mass[g] = volume[mL] * 1.036. Same contributors and weights in both representations. Sample-size-weighted arithmetic mean; unknown n has equal-report weight 1, not an assumed animal count. One source representation per team; primary reports preferred, secondary reports fill species gaps. Existing calculated masses retain their reported grams; their volume is a density-equivalent estimate, not a recovered original volume. Endocranial capacity is a proxy and includes non-brain contents. Preparation and methods are not corrected. Output: mass in grams.
